dialogue.content: こんにちわ相談員です。
dialogue.English: Hello, this is the counselor.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for speaking with me.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いします！
dialogue.English: It's a pleasure.

dialogue.content: 今日はどんなご相談でいらっしゃいましたか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: くだらない内容かも知れないのですが、、
dialogue.English: This might sound like a trivial matter, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 聞いていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Would you be willing to listen?

dialogue.content: はい、どうぞ！
dialogue.English: Yes, please go ahead!

dialogue.content: 職場の人間関係のことなんですが、
dialogue.English: It's about my relationships at work.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 小さな家族的会社でお米を全国に発送している事務をしています。
dialogue.English: I work as an office clerk at a small, family-run company that ships rice nationwide.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 社長の他に奥様と社長のお母さんと
dialogue.English: Besides the president, there's his wife and his mother,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 私と他にスタッフが３人でやっているのですが、
dialogue.English: and then there's me and three other staff members.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 最近、入った女性の新人さんが
dialogue.English: Recently, a new female employee joined,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はじめは明るくて人当たりもよかったのですが、
dialogue.English: At first, she was cheerful and seemed very pleasant,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 入って三ヶ月過ぎたあたりから
dialogue.English: but after about three months,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 先輩である私の悪口を言いふらしているようなんです。
dialogue.English: it seems she's been spreading gossip about me, her senior colleague.

dialogue.content: ええーー、そうなんですか
dialogue.English: Oh, really?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あっ、すいません、続けてください
dialogue.English: Oh, I'm sorry, please continue.

dialogue.content: 会社は家族経営的な感じなんですが
dialogue.English: The company has a family-run feel,

dialogue.content: 社長の奥様が少し
dialogue.English: The president’s wife is a bit...

dialogue.content: 言いにくいのですが
dialogue.English: This is hard to say, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 知的障害がすこしある感じで
dialogue.English: it seems she has a mild intellectual disability.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 日中もボーっとしていることが多くて、
dialogue.English: She often seems spaced out during the day,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 何をやるにもスローだし、たくさんのことを同時にできないんですね
dialogue.English: she's slow at everything and can't multitask.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 私も最初はあれって？思ったのですが
dialogue.English: At first, I thought it was strange, too,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 徐々にこれは疾患のひとつなんだなぁーと
dialogue.English: but I gradually realized this is part of a condition.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 本人は全く悪気はなくて
dialogue.English: She doesn't mean any harm at all,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: 社長もすごく良い人柄なんです
dialogue.English: and the president is a very good person.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 知的障害を軽度に持っていることを承知で結婚されたようです。
dialogue.English: He seems to have married her knowing she has a mild intellectual disability.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: その新人が
dialogue.English: That new employee...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その奥様の何というか、、、
dialogue.English: About the president’s wife, how should I put it...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 仕事をサボっているとか
dialogue.English: Saying she’s slacking off at work,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 奥様に対して非難めいた言動が多くなり
dialogue.English: her critical remarks toward the wife have increased,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: こっちは忙しいのになんにもしないとか
dialogue.English: things like, 'We’re busy here and she does nothing,'

dialogue.content: 私に苦情を言ってくるようになったんですね
dialogue.English: and she started complaining to me about it.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 私はもともと人の悪口を言うのは好きではなく
dialogue.English: I don't like speaking ill of others to begin with,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まして知的障害があることを承知で
dialogue.English: especially knowing she has an intellectual disability,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: 家族経営上社員として配置されている事情もわかっていたので
dialogue.English: and I understood the circumstances of her being an employee in a family-run business.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: その新人によくわかるように何度も説明したんですが
dialogue.English: so I explained the situation to the new colleague many times so she would understand,

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 最初はあー、そうなんですねーと聞いていたのですが
dialogue.English: At first, she seemed to listen, saying, 'Oh, I see,'

dialogue.content: そのうちに奥様の悪口を私に毎日言ってくるようになり
dialogue.English: but eventually, she started badmouthing the wife to me every day.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私は本人はそれは生まれもったものだから
dialogue.English: I told her that it's something she was born with,

dialogue.content: 仕方ないことなんだよといくら言ってもエスカレートしてきて
dialogue.English: and that it can't be helped, but no matter how many times I said it, things just escalated.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 最近では
dialogue.English: And recently,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 他の男性のスタッフに私の悪口まで言うようになってきてしまい、、、
dialogue.English: she's even started badmouthing me to the other male staff...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ほとほと会社に行くのが嫌になってしまい、、
dialogue.English: I've really come to dread going to work...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: この先どのように気持ちを整理したらいいのか？
dialogue.English: I don't know how to sort out my feelings about this going forward.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいでしょうか？相談に乗ってもらえますか？
dialogue.English: What should I do? Could you offer some advice?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はい、、いろいろお話頂き有難うございます
dialogue.English: Yes... thank you for sharing all of that with me.

dialogue.content: まずは、、
dialogue.English: First of all...

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 最初にくだらない話しとおっしゃってましたが、、
dialogue.English: You mentioned at the beginning that this might be a trivial matter,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 全然くだらないことではなく、
dialogue.English: but this isn't trivial at all.

dialogue.content: はい、、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: お仕事の、職場の大切な問題ですよね、
dialogue.English: It's a very important issue concerning your job and your workplace.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。最近は夜もあんまり眠れない感じで、、、
dialogue.English: That's right. Lately, I haven't been able to sleep very well at night...

dialogue.content: いろいろと悩まれてるのが分かりました、問題も何点かあり、気苦労されてますよね
dialogue.English: I understand that you're troubled by many things. There seem to be several issues, and you're under a lot of mental stress.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよね。それ以外にも
dialogue.English: That's right. And besides that...

dialogue.content: そうですか、それほど不安を感じてるんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you're feeling that anxious.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あっ、はい、どうぞ
dialogue.English: Oh, yes, please go on.

dialogue.content: その彼女はお米を発送する際の送付状とかも雑に貼るんですね。いくら注意しても直さないんです。
dialogue.English: She's also sloppy when she puts on the shipping labels for the rice. No matter how many times I point it out, she doesn't change.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、そういった事でも不満をお持ちなんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you're also frustrated by things like that.

dialogue.content: はい。受け取ったお客様が嫌な感じを持ってしまうので、私は丁寧な貼るように指導するのですが、
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm concerned the customers who receive it will have a bad impression, so I try to guide her to be neater,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 人当たりは悪くないのですが、仕事が雑なんですね。
dialogue.English: She's not a bad person to deal with, but her work is sloppy.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、厄介ですねー
dialogue.English: I see... that’s tricky.

dialogue.content: そうなんです、、、
dialogue.English: Exactly...

dialogue.content: 毎日毎日、大変な思いをされてるのが目に浮かびます
dialogue.English: I can picture how difficult this must be for you every day.

dialogue.content: ほんとうですか。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Really? Thank you.

dialogue.content: 先ほど、
dialogue.English: Earlier,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 寝れてないとのことでしたが、そこはそんな状況でしょうか？
dialogue.English: you mentioned you haven't been sleeping well. Could you tell me more about that?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: うちに帰っても
dialogue.English: Even when I get home,

dialogue.content: 気分がもやもやして、
dialogue.English: I feel unsettled,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 夜もなかなか寝付けない感じで眠りも浅い感じなんです。
dialogue.English: and at night, I have trouble falling asleep, and my sleep feels very light.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、睡眠は大切なので、心配ですね。
dialogue.English: I see... Sleep is so important, so that is a concern.

dialogue.content: 何時間くらい寝れてますか？
dialogue.English: About how many hours of sleep are you getting?

dialogue.content: はい。大体5時間程度だと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes. I think it's about 5 hours.

dialogue.content: それは少ないですね、、
dialogue.English: That's not very much...

dialogue.content: あさも疲れが抜けない感じで。
dialogue.English: In the morning, I still feel tired.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、、
dialogue.English: I can imagine...

dialogue.content: 疲れが取れない感じですよね
dialogue.English: It must feel like you're never fully rested.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今までせっかく頑張ってきた仕事を辞めたくはないんです。
dialogue.English: I don't want to quit the job I've worked so hard at all this time.

dialogue.content: はい、なるほど、、そうお考えなのですね
dialogue.English: Yes, I see... so that's how you feel.

dialogue.content: はいしかし、、、
dialogue.English: Yes, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: この職場は三年目になるのですが。
dialogue.English: I've been at this job for three years now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 前の職場でもやはり周りに悪口を言う女性スタッフがいて精神的にまいって辞めたんですね、、、
dialogue.English: At my previous job, there was also a female colleague who would gossip about everyone, and it took such a mental toll on me that I quit...

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: だからいまの職場はその新人が入る前はすごくやりやすい職場だったので
dialogue.English: That's why this current workplace was a really comfortable place to work before the new employee joined,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: 私は人の悪口を言うのも聞くのも本当に嫌なんです。
dialogue.English: I really hate both saying and hearing bad things about people.

dialogue.content: はい、そうですよね、嫌ですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand. It's very unpleasant.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、、
dialogue.English: By the way...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 新人さんが入ってくる前はどんな感じの職場だったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What was the workplace like before the new employee joined?

dialogue.content: みんなほんわかして和気藹々としてました。
dialogue.English: Everyone was warm and friendly, and we all got along harmoniously.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、そんな職場いいでよね
dialogue.English: I see... A workplace like that sounds wonderful.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: であればなおさら、
dialogue.English: In that case, all the more reason,

dialogue.content: 辞めずに、改善できる方法を、一緒に考えてみましょう。
dialogue.English: let's think together about ways to improve the situation so you don't have to quit.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Thank you!

dialogue.content: それと、一番気になるのは、睡眠のところですが、、
dialogue.English: Also, what concerns me most is your sleep...

dialogue.content: はい、、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 病院に行ったりはされてますか？
dialogue.English: Have you seen a doctor about it?

dialogue.content: いいえ。私は病院があまり好きではなくて。薬とかには頼りたくなんいんですね。
dialogue.English: No. I don't really like going to the doctor. I don't want to rely on medication.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、わかりました。
dialogue.English: I see... I understand.

dialogue.content: 本当は
dialogue.English: Ideally,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 仕事が終わったらオンとオフをうまく切り替えてうちではリラックスしたいんですが、、、なんだか頭から離れなくて
dialogue.English: when work is over, I'd like to be able to switch off and relax at home... but I just can't get it off my mind.

dialogue.content: どうしたら良いでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: なるほど、、そうですよね、切り替えたいですよね
dialogue.English: I understand... Of course, you want to be able to switch off.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私は気にし過ぎなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Am I worrying about it too much?

dialogue.content: ちなみに、ストレス軽減のための何かに取り組まれたりしてますか？
dialogue.English: By the way, are you doing anything to relieve your stress?

dialogue.content: それが前はストレッチ教室に通っていたのですが今、コロナで自粛中で、、、
dialogue.English: Well, I used to go to a stretching class, but it's on hold due to COVID...

dialogue.content: なるほど、、コロナ禍ですからね
dialogue.English: I see... It's difficult with the pandemic.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよね。なんか気分が落ち込むことが多くて、、、
dialogue.English: That's right. I've been feeling down a lot lately...

dialogue.content: 本当は、職場離れたら、気持ちを切り替え、五感を使った楽しみができればいいのですが、、
dialogue.English: Ideally, once you leave work, it would be great if you could switch gears and find enjoyment through activities that engage your five senses,

dialogue.content: 今の状況の中では厳しいですよね
dialogue.English: but that's difficult under the current circumstances.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、ムーさんとお呼びして宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By the way, may I call you Muu-san?

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ムーさんは、一番は、何がどうなれば寝れるようになりそうですか？
dialogue.English: Muu-san, what do you think would need to change for you to be able to sleep better?

dialogue.content: そうですね、、、
dialogue.English: Let's see...

dialogue.content: 新人さんが
dialogue.English: If the new colleague...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 奥様の悪口を言わないようになりさらに仕事をひとつひとつ丁寧に気持ちを込めてやってもらえたらと願います。
dialogue.English: I wish she would stop badmouthing the president's wife and also start doing her work carefully and with more care.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、そこ重要ですよね
dialogue.English: I see... that's very important, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 奥様の悪口が一番引っかかってる感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does the badmouthing of the president's wife bother you the most?

dialogue.content: そうなんです！
dialogue.English: Exactly!

dialogue.content: そこです！
dialogue.English: That's it!

dialogue.content: 自分のまわりには人の悪口を言うような友達はいないから余計に違和感と嫌悪感があります。
dialogue.English: None of my friends are the type to gossip about others, so it feels especially strange and repulsive to me.

dialogue.content: ムーさんのお話を聞いてると、そこですよね。
dialogue.English: Listening to you, Muu-san, that seems to be the core of the issue.

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: Yes!

dialogue.content: よく
dialogue.English: Right,

dialogue.content: 人の悪口は聞きたくもないし、言いたくいもない
dialogue.English: you don't want to hear gossip, and you don't want to say it either.

dialogue.content: そうなんです！
dialogue.English: Exactly!

dialogue.content: 悪口って、聞いてる方も、嫌な気分なってきちゃいますよね
dialogue.English: When you hear gossip, it makes you feel bad too, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: たしかに、その通りですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's exactly right.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、悪口なくなれば、寝れそうですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, if the gossip were to stop, do you think you'd be able to sleep?

dialogue.content: うーん。そうですね。
dialogue.English: Hmm. I think so.

dialogue.content: 仕事が雑なことよりそちらがひっかかります。
dialogue.English: That bothers me more than her sloppy work.

dialogue.content: そうですか、まだ何か気になる事あれば、おしゃってください。
dialogue.English: I see. If there's anything else that's bothering you, please feel free to share.

dialogue.content: よく他人は変えられないから自分を変えるしかないと言われますが
dialogue.English: People often say you can't change others, only yourself,

dialogue.content: 私の場合どのように自分の気の持ちようを変えたら良いものか？とも考えたりします。
dialogue.English: and I wonder how I should change my own mindset in this situation.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、そういった事も悩んでるんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so that's something you're struggling with as well.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 不安と不満が入り混じってる感じですね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're feeling a mix of anxiety and frustration.

dialogue.content: そうですね、
dialogue.English: Yes, I think so.

dialogue.content: 了解しました、少し一緒に考えてみましょう
dialogue.English: Understood. Let's think about this together.

dialogue.content: すみません、、、
dialogue.English: Thank you...

dialogue.content: ちなみに、これらの事は、誰かに相談されたりしてましたか？
dialogue.English: By the way, have you talked to anyone else about this?

dialogue.content: 親しい友人にだけは相談しました。そしたらその新人はきっとどこに行っても人の悪口を言う性格なんじゃないかと。だかり気にしないようにと、、、
dialogue.English: I've only spoken to a close friend. She said that the new colleague probably has a personality that leads her to gossip no matter where she is, and that I should try not to let it bother me...

dialogue.content: なるほど、ご友人と相談されてるんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you've discussed it with your friend.

dialogue.content: それで、ムーさんはどう思いましたか？
dialogue.English: And what did you think of that, Muu-san?

dialogue.content: はい。てもやっぱり気になってしまって、、
dialogue.English: Yes. But it still really bothers me...

dialogue.content: そうですよね、気にしないようにはすぐにはなれない感じですかね
dialogue.English: I understand. It's not something you can just immediately stop worrying about, is it?

dialogue.content: 一つお聞きしたいのですが、、
dialogue.English: I'd like to ask you one thing...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: その新人さんは、なぜ悪口を言うのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Why do you think the new employee is badmouthing people?

dialogue.content: そうですね、、、
dialogue.English: Well...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 奥様が日中にデスクでうとうとしたりする場面があるんですね、、、
dialogue.English: Well, there are times during the day when the president's wife dozes off at her desk...

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私とかまわりのスタッフは
dialogue.English: The other staff and I,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは仕方ないことと割り切っているんです。
dialogue.English: have come to terms with it as something that can't be helped.

dialogue.content: しかし、
dialogue.English: However,

dialogue.content: 彼女は
dialogue.English: she

dialogue.content: 許されない！と、私に奥様を注意してくださいとけしかけるんです。
dialogue.English: says, 'It's unacceptable!' and urges me to reprimand the wife.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 本来なら
dialogue.English: Normally,

dialogue.content: 家族経営上奥様を社員にして様々な経費とかを調整するのはわかるのですが、、、他のスタッフのモチベーションが落ちる部分もあるから
dialogue.English: I understand that in a family-run business, making the wife an employee is a way to manage various expenses, but it can also lower the motivation of other staff,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あまり事務所には無理して配置しない方が良いのはみんなわかっているんです。
dialogue.English: so everyone understands it would be better not to force her into a position in the office if it's not a good fit.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私も最初そうでした。だから新人にはこれは仕方ないことなんですよ、、、とよーく説明したのですが、、、
dialogue.English: I was the same way at first. That's why I carefully explained to the new colleague that it's just something that can't be helped, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 奥様を注意しない私にまでとばっちりがきてしまい、、、
dialogue.English: now I'm catching the fallout for not reprimanding the wife...

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 他の男性スタッフもその新人に仕方ないことだよと教えてくれているのに、、、
dialogue.English: Even though the other male staff are also telling her that it can't be helped...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 知的障害をお持ちの方は見た目には普通に写るかも知れませんが
dialogue.English: People with intellectual disabilities may look typical on the surface, but

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 悪気があって居眠りとかしている訳ではないんですよね、、、
dialogue.English: she isn't dozing off out of malice...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そう思います
dialogue.English: I think so too.

dialogue.content: 但し、、
dialogue.English: However...

dialogue.content: （宜しいでしょうか？）
dialogue.English: (May I continue?)

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 新人さんが言ってる事は、健常者であれば、やってはいけない居眠りですよね
dialogue.English: What the new colleague is saying is that, for someone without a disability, dozing off at work is not acceptable, correct?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 周りの男性スタッフさんも新人さんに教えてるようならば、、
dialogue.English: And if the other male staff are also explaining it to the new colleague...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 本当はこの件は、社長に一度ご相談頂くもの一つかと思いますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Perhaps one course of action might be to discuss this matter with the president. What do you think?

dialogue.content: あっ、なるほど！
dialogue.English: Oh, I see!

dialogue.content: 障害者だから、居眠りを許される職場か、、
dialogue.English: Is this a workplace where dozing off is permitted because she has a disability...

dialogue.content: それで給料でるようなら
dialogue.English: and if she's getting paid for that,

dialogue.content: 納得できない人もいらっしゃるかもですね
dialogue.English: it's understandable that some people might not be satisfied with that.

dialogue.content: それと、、
dialogue.English: Also...

dialogue.content: ムーさんおお話をお聞きしてて思うのですが、
dialogue.English: Listening to your story, Muu-san, I get the sense that,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ムーさんは非常に真面目で、気配りもあり、会社の事、同僚の事、いっぱいいろんな事を，、
dialogue.English: you are a very earnest and considerate person. You think about the company, your colleagues, and so many different things...

dialogue.content: 心配され、気にかけていただいて、、
dialogue.English: You worry and care about them...

dialogue.content: 素晴らしい人柄の方と感じます。
dialogue.English: I feel you have a wonderful character.

dialogue.content: ただし、
dialogue.English: However,

dialogue.content: 睡眠が取れてないのが、大病にも繋がりますので、
dialogue.English: not getting enough sleep can lead to serious illness,

dialogue.content: 早々に改善された方がいいかと思います
dialogue.English: so I think it's best to resolve this as soon as possible.

dialogue.content: そこで、、ご友人にも相談されてると思いますが、
dialogue.English: So... I know you've spoken with your friend,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 社長や、同僚の方々には、相談や話をされる事をお勧めしたいdれす。話すことで、少しはスッキリすることもあると思いますので
dialogue.English: but I would recommend you also discuss this with the president and your other colleagues. Talking about it might help you feel a little better.

dialogue.content: あっ、確かに！
dialogue.English: Oh, that's true!

dialogue.content: ムーさん、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you think, Muu-san?

dialogue.content: 肝心の大事な部分が抜けていたことに今、気づきました！
dialogue.English: I just realized I was missing the most crucial part!

dialogue.content: そうですか！
dialogue.English: Is that so!

dialogue.content: そうですよね！
dialogue.English: That's right!

dialogue.content: 気づきがあって良かったです
dialogue.English: I'm glad you had that realization.

dialogue.content: おかげで大切なことに気づきました！ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Thanks to you, I've realized something important! Thank you!

dialogue.content: いいえ、こちらこそいろいろ話して頂き有難うございました。
dialogue.English: Not at all. Thank you for sharing so much with me.

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間ですが、今日はこの辺で宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: We’re almost out of time. Shall we wrap up for today?

dialogue.content: はい。本当にありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you so much!

dialogue.content: お世話になりました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your help.

dialogue.content: また次回、お話しお聞かせ頂きたいと思いますので、ぜひいらしてください。
dialogue.English: I'd like to hear how things go next time, so please do come again.

dialogue.content: 有難うございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。また、宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to speaking with you again.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いします。本日は有難うございました。
dialogue.English: Of course. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you.
